blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 67 in June to 57 in October (−14.9%), and it took 30.5% of the city’s 154 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 15 in June to 16 in October (+6.7%), and it took 26.2% of the city’s 42 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Nordel for detached houses in June, August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July, October (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, September, October (a sellers’ best bet).

Established-street house lots: freehold detached houses on the established streets, with strata condos and townhomes concentrated along 84 Avenue and in the Sunstone / Delsom Crescent pocket at the south side. No City source names a predominant zone for Nordel — zoning is parcel-by-parcel.

Lot character from the zone ladder, as stated: the residential ladder runs from RS1 at a 4,000 m² subdivision minimum through RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² or 460 m², RS6 at 390 m² and RS7 at 335 m², with duplex zones RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m²; there is no RD5 zone. Urban subdivision minimums therefore run from 335 m² (RS7) to 4,000 m² (RS1/RS2/RS3) in lower-density pockets; the zone for a specific lot is confirmed on the City zoning maps. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size.

Serviced position, as the City states it: Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home, covering garbage/recycling and, where applicable, water and sewer — Nordel's established lots sit inside the City's serviced urban system on that wording.

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR parcel in Nordel is confirmed; ALR status is a property-specific check through the Agricultural Land Commission, and the west edge borders Burns Bog / Delta Nature Reserve, protected as the Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area — protected conservancy land, not buildable lot area. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats has no land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: Nordel sub-area detached inventory 56 / sales 6 (11% ratio) and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 12 / 2 (17% ratio); North Delta community detached median $1,100,000 and attached median $622,500.

Sunbury Terrace — 8376 Centre Street. Bare-land strata (Strata Plan NWS2806, per a directory record — secondary source): Built 1989 per current listings, which record Title to Land: Freehold Strata and describe a boutique bare-land strata community of just 12 units, designed like half-duplexes. One listing describes "no strata rules" for the complex.
"Sunstone" is the alternate/search name for the master-planned townhome community on Delsom Crescent at Nordel's south side, described by its developer, Polygon.

An apartment and townhouse project proposed inside the ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area. Application stage — no completed complex, no strata plan, no lot or unit count published in the material read.
A mixed-use residential and commercial building proposed inside the ND12 permit area. Application stage, not built stock.

blocks.text: Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Nordel is in North Delta, the part of the City of Delta north of Burns Bog and south of the Fraser River.

The ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area in the 2024 OCP is centred on 84 Avenue and 112 Street, running roughly from 86 Avenue toward the 82 Avenue blocks between 112/114 Streets and 116 Street, with a stated objective to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta.

Nearby areas: Annieville to the north-west, Richardson and Sunbury Park to the north, Scottsdale and Sunshine Hills Woods to the east and south-east, Burns Bog / Delta Nature Reserve at the west edge.

Main roads: Nordel Way runs east–west across the area toward the Highway 91 interchange and the Alex Fraser Bridge; 112 Street and 116 Street run north–south; 84 Avenue is the central east–west street. Transit: route 312 (Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 112 Street, with stops at Nordel Way) and route 391 (via 116 Street, also stopping at Nordel Way), both connecting to the Expo Line at Scott Road Station.

Civic core in the Social Heart: North Delta Recreation Centre, 11415 84 Avenue; North Delta Community Park, 11311 84 Avenue (pickleball, picnic tables, playgrounds, skate park, sports fields, tennis courts, trails, washrooms); George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street; North Delta Public Health Unit, 11245 84 Avenue; Delta Nature Reserve access at 10388 Nordel Court, at the west edge. Nearest hospital: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner.
Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based, with no middle-school tier.

OCP — consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024): the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400, applies — the current OCP consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan, including the ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area in Appendix B of Bylaw No. 8400.

West-edge environmental diligence: the Delta Nature Reserve / Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area borders Nordel at the west edge — for lots near the Bog, check development-permit and environmental conditions early; setback or covenant surprises surface late in deals.

Bare-land strata rules (Sunbury Terrace — the BC strata block applies in full to the lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024 (Sunbury Terrace at 12 lots is inside the requirement, and as 1989 stock its report is the roof/lot-services check); minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

If a parcel is in the ALR: subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified. On ALR land the main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is allowed only inside it, and an extra residence can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha). For farm class, BC Assessment looks for farm income of $10,000 a year on under 0.8 ha, $2,500 on 0.8 to 4 ha, and $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha; applications are due by October 31. Check the parcel on ALC mapping before applying any of this.
Foreclosure geography (for any court-ordered Nordel land): 21(2)).

The Social Heart is a permit area, not just a nickname (2024 OCP): ND12's stated objective is to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta, and both active applications (LU009689, LU009611) sit inside it — lots inside the permit area carry different development expectations than the quiet interior streets.

The west edge is a conservancy, not a future phase: Delta Nature Reserve access is at 10388 Nordel Court and Burns Bog is protected as an Ecological Conservancy Area — west-edge "land" value is view/quiet value, not expansion value.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Nordel
The one community documented here is a bare-land strata: the buyer owns the lot and the home on it.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Transit: Route 312 runs Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 72 Avenue, 112 Street, 92A Avenue, 114 Street, 96 Avenue and Scott Road, with stops at Nordel Way; route 391 runs Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 72 Avenue, 116 Street and 96 Avenue, also stopping at Nordel Way; both connect to the Expo Line at Scott Road Station.
Where the mobile-form stock sits: Sunbury Terrace is on Centre Street, an interior street in the established residential grid — not on the 84 Avenue corridor and not in the Sunstone pocket.

Nordel's only bare-land strata is also its oldest strata stock: Sunbury Terrace (1989, 12 units) predates the entire Sunstone/Delsom Crescent pocket by two decades-plus, and at 12 lots it sits inside the mandatory five-year depreciation-report cycle — for a 1989 bare-land strata, that report is the roof and lot-services check, a different document from a Sunstone envelope report.

Nordel's civic core is also its development front: The ND12 Social Heart permit area centred on 84 Avenue and 112 Street — library, recreation centre, community park, public health unit — is the same area carrying those two applications; lots inside the permit area carry different development expectations than the quiet interior streets where Sunbury Terrace sits.

The seniors centre's age is 50+ and the seniors bus's age is 65+: Kennedy Seniors Recreation Centre is billed as recreation for 50+; the Delta Seniors Bus is for residents 65+. Neither threshold is a 55+ housing rule — check the threshold for the specific service, and never read either as evidence a Nordel complex is age-restricted.

faq.q: Is there a vacant lot subdivision I can buy into in Nordel?
faq.a: No known one — Nordel is an established residential area; land trades as built house lots, strata units, and Social Heart assemblies/applications.

faq.q: What does "bare-land strata" at Sunbury Terrace actually mean?
faq.a: You own a bare-land strata lot (Plan NWS2806 per a directory record) in a 12-unit, 1989 half-duplex-style community at 8376 Centre Street — you pay strata fees, follow the bylaws and get a Form B, but your lot is land with your home on it, which changes how lot-level responsibilities and insurance sit versus a conventional townhouse strata. Read the strata plan and bylaws, not just the Form B summary.

faq.q: Is Delta Gardens in Nordel, Scottsdale or Annieville?
faq.a: Listings use all three names for the one complex.

faq.q: Can a Nordel house lot add a suite, coach house or garden suite?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH framework (Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) permits small-scale multi-unit housing on all single-detached and duplex lots citywide, and Delta permits secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies — eligibility is parcel-specific.

faq.q: Is more supply coming to the Social Heart, and can I buy a lot in it?
faq.a: Two applications were active — LU009689 (apartment and townhouse, 112 Street and 82 Avenue) and LU009611 (mixed-use, 112 Street and 84 Avenue), both inside ND12.

faq.q: Is there a mobile home park in Nordel?
faq.a: The closest form is Sunbury Terrace, a bare-land strata where you own the lot.

faq.q: Are the Sunbury Terrace homes manufactured homes?
faq.a: Check the specific home: title, any Manufactured Home Registry record, and the CSA label if it is factory-built.

faq.q: A listing says Sunbury Terrace has "no strata rules" — can I rely on that?
faq.a: Every strata has filed bylaws; read them with the Form B, which also discloses the fee, amounts owed, approved levies and CRF balance.
